summary: CoreWeave Inc. has sweetened terms on a $2.6 billion loan to fund additional computing capacity for firms including Anthropic PBC in an effort to win over investors growing wary of AI-related debt as bubble concerns mount.

title: Ford Shares Climb as Profit-Rich SUVs Drive Outlook Higher
summary:
Ford Motor Co. raised its profit outlook for the second time this year as consumers continue to snap up the automaker’s high-margin sport-utility vehicles.
The rosier forecast, revealed late Tuesday as the automaker reported better-than-expected quarterly earnings, shows how Ford is cashing in on resilient demand for SUVs and pickups, echoing a similar move by rival General Motors Co. last week.  Bloomberg's Craig Trudell joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Wall Street Races to Sell SpaceX-Linked Notes as Stock Sinks
summary: Wall Street is racing to roll out complex investment products tied to SpaceX shares that aim to shield buyers from future losses amid a sharp selloff following its market debut.

title: Visa Beats Estimates, Takes $563 Million Charge on Job Cuts
summary: Visa reported a fiscal third-quarter profit that beat Wall Street estimates hours after the world’s biggest payments network told staff that it will eliminate roughly 2,600 jobs. Bloomberg Intelligence's Diksha Gera joins to discuss. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: China’s CMOC Makes Iron Ore Push With Brazil Mine Financing Deal
summary: The trading arm of Chinese copper giant CMOC Group Ltd. is making a push into iron ore with a deal to finance a mining company in Brazil.

title: Emerging Stocks Extend Losses, Most Currencies Drop Before Fed
summary: Emerging-market stocks plunged for a second day as a rout in Asian chip stocks deepened, while most currencies weakened ahead of the Federal Reserve’s interest-rate decision.

title: BMO Completes SRTs Tied to $5 Billion of Corporate Loans
summary: Bank of Montreal recently completed two significant risk transfers covering about $5 billion of corporate loans, becoming the latest Canadian lender to tap strong investor demand for the instruments.

title: New Age of Missiles, Drones Reshapes Battlefields Around The World
summary:
The world is on the cusp of a third missile age, with conventional ballistic weapons proliferating at unprecedented speed in the wake of widespread, battlefield-warping deployment in Iran and Ukraine. 
Paul Scharre, Executive Director at the Center for a New American Security, discusses this new age of military technology and his Foreign Affairs piece, "Losing the War of the Future: How New Technologies Threaten America’s Military Advantage." (Source: Bloomberg)

title: L'Oréal CEO Sees Strong Demand for Haircare Products
summary: The CEO of L'Oréal, the world’s largest cosmetics company, says the performance in the Middle East was below expectations but somewhat compensated by a rebound of growth in China. Nicolas Hieronimus spoke exclusively with Bloomberg’s Francine Lacqua from Paris. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Guyana's Extraordinary Opportunity
summary: Bloomberg Opinion columnist Juan Pablo Spinetto went to Guyana to explore the enormous organizational challenges behind what is arguably the world’s most extraordinary nation-building experiment. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: CDS Market Surges as Wall Street Picks AI’s Winners and Losers
summary: As Big Tech barrels toward trillions of dollars of planned spending on AI, a key cog in credit markets is showing signs of pressure. That, in turn, is lifting the cost of financing artificial intelligence while offering an early look at potential winners and losers.

title: European Stocks Retreat on Glum Hermes Earnings, Iran Jitters
summary: European stocks dropped after underwhelming results from Hermes International SCA and ASM International NV added to investor caution as tensions in the Middle East intensified.

title: China’s Zijin Gold and Allied Gold Scrap $3.9 Billion Merger
summary: Zijin Gold International Co.’s C$5.5 billion ($3.9 billion) takeover of Canada’s Allied Gold Corp. was scrapped after the mining deal failed to get Chinese regulatory approvals ahead of a contractual deadline. Shares of the Toronto-based metals producer plunged.

title: US Consumers Continue to Grow More Cautious
summary:
US consumer confidence fell in July as Americans’ views about current business conditions and the labor market deteriorated. 
Elevated gasoline and food prices likely weighed on US households, underscoring broader concerns about persistent inflation and the rising cost of living.
Julia Wilson, Principal: Consumer & Retail Strategy at KPMG, talks about the squeezed consumer and the back-to-school ramp-up affecting economic data. (Source: Bloomberg)

title: Grant Thornton to Buy Advisory Firm CBIZ in $5 Billion Deal
summary: Grant Thornton’s US arm has agreed to buy rival accountant CBIZ Inc. in a deal that values the target firm at $5 billion, marking one of the largest professional services acquisitions in recent years.
